occurrences.finding: Infants sleep in Designated Crib, Cot, Bed, or Mat: During the follow up, a 3 month old was observed asleep on the ground on a boppy pillow. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver placed the 3 month old in their crib.

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children: During the follow up, one caregiver was observed with 11 children. occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children (26 TAC §746.1701)
